title: DeepSeek prepares IPO, reportedly chasing about $71bn valuation
summary: DeepSeek is reported to be preparing a listing and seeking about $1.5bn of fresh funding at roughly $71bn weeks after its first outside round; a filing could come by end-2026.

title: Stripe in talks to buy AI model marketplace OpenRouter for about $10 billion
summary: Payments firm Stripe is reported in talks to acquire OpenRouter, an AI model marketplace, at about $10bn versus a $1.3bn valuation set in a CapitalG-led round in May; WSJ-sourced.

title: Software firm CCC Intelligent Solutions exploring sale, sources say
summary: Insurance-claims software company CCC has hired Morgan Stanley and approached prospective buyers including private equity firms; shares rose 13% on the report.
